title: Document multi-machine beads sync; de-machine-ify memories
description: Two problems found while auditing. (1) Beads memories travel between machines via the git-tracked .beads/issues.jsonl (the embeddeddolt DB is gitignored), so any machine-local fact stored in a memory is read as truth on the other machine and is false there. Two of four memories are polluted this way. (2) Auto-import on pull depends on core.hooksPath pointing at .beads/hooks, which is --local git config and therefore NOT tracked by git. If it is unset on the second machine, git pull does not import, and that machine's next bd write exports issues.jsonl from a stale DB — committing that can delete the other machine's issues. Needs documenting in CLAUDE.md plus a CLAUDE.local.md convention for machine-local facts.
acceptance_criteria: CLAUDE.md documents the multi-machine sync contract and the core.hooksPath prerequisite; CLAUDE.local.md is gitignored and holds machine-local facts; the two polluted memories contain only clone-and-machine-independent facts.
close_reason: CLAUDE.md now documents the memory-scope rule and multi-machine sync contract (core.hooksPath prerequisite, post-pull import check, stale-export data-loss path, jsonl conflict procedure). CLAUDE.local.md gitignored and populated. Two polluted memories rewritten; memory-hygiene rule added as its own memory.

title: Gate ruff via .beads/hooks/pre-commit; clear broken pre-commit env cache
description:
Root cause of the recurring lint/hygiene drift (see vndb-client-a21): the beads integration sets core.hooksPath to .beads/hooks, and the Python pre-commit framework refuses to install while that is set ('Cowardly refusing to install hooks with core.hooksPath set'). So make install has never actually gated ruff, and bd does not chain to .git/hooks or to pre-commit.

Verified fix path (tested 2026-07-25 on a throwaway branch): content placed in .beads/hooks/pre-commit BELOW the END BEADS INTEGRATION marker runs after bd's own block, a non-zero exit from it blocks the commit, and 'bd hooks install --beads' preserves it across reinstall. .beads/hooks/ is git-tracked, so the gate propagates to every clone automatically.

BLOCKED first by a filesystem fault: C:/Users/ml-na/.cache/pre-commit/repog4dqji1n/py_env-python3 denies access even to Get-Acl unelevated, and pre-commit dies trying to rmtree it during env setup. Needs an elevated shell to remove. Do not add the hook line before this is fixed — every commit would fail.
acceptance_criteria: pre-commit env builds ('uv run pre-commit run --all-files' completes); .beads/hooks/pre-commit invokes it below the END marker; a deliberate ruff violation is blocked at commit time; the change is committed so the other workstation inherits it.

title: Honor Retry-After on transient 5xx (502/503), not just 429
description: Code-review finding (enhancement). RetryPolicy.next only applies a Retry-After delay when status==429 (core.py:115); for retryable 502/503 it falls back to exponential backoff even when the server sent Retry-After. Current behavior is compliant with the archived request-retry spec (which scopes Retry-After to 429), so this is a future enhancement: consider applying retry_after whenever present for any retryable status, and update the spec accordingly. Found during /code-review of foundation-transport-core.

value: PEP 639 license gotcha (hatchling >=1.27 emits Metadata-Version 2.4): in pyproject [project], using the SPDX 'license = "MIT"' expression AND a 'License :: OSI Approved :: ...' trove classifier together is forbidden and modern twine/PyPI reject the upload. Use the SPDX license field + license-files only; do NOT also add a License:: classifier. twine check may still pass locally but the upload fails. Verify by building the wheel and inspecting METADATA for both License-Expression and Classifier: License lines.

Superpowers 6.2.0 predates Opus 5 and has zero Opus-5 awareness; parts of it are now counterproductive per Anthropic's Opus 5 prompting guide (explicit verification instructions cause over-verification; do not use subagents to double-check your own work; Opus 5 delegates to subagents too readily). This repo's CLAUDE.md carries a 'Superpowers overrides (Opus 5)' section that neutralizes verification-before-completion, SDD's per-task reviewer loop, writing-plans, and the brainstorming HARD-GATE — CLAUDE.md is the authority, read it there. Never edit the superpowers plugin cache under the Claude config dir to apply overrides: it is version-pinned and overwritten on plugin update, so overrides belong in CLAUDE.md, which the skills themselves concede outranks them.

Beads memories are NOT machine-local: the embeddeddolt DB is gitignored but .beads/issues.jsonl IS tracked, and 'bd import' round-trips both issues and memories, so every memory is read as truth on every machine and clone. Rule: a memory may contain ONLY facts true in any clone on any machine — repo structure, toolchain behavior, project conventions, published-artifact gotchas. Machine-local facts (paths under the home dir, agent-sandbox quirks, which optional tools happen to be installed, harness permissions) must NOT go in a memory; they become false on the other machine. Put those in CLAUDE.local.md, which is gitignored.

Workflow 2 ordering: after implementation (step 6), ALWAYS run /opsx:verify (7) and /opsx:archive (8) BEFORE /code-review (9) and /superpowers:finishing-a-development-branch (10). Passing a code review does NOT replace opsx:verify/opsx:archive — they are separate gates. In the query-builder cycle these were skipped before merge and had to be completed retroactively on main: mark tasks.md [x], then 'openspec archive <name> --yes' to sync the capability spec into openspec/specs/. (Renumbered 2026-07-25 when /superpowers:writing-plans was dropped from Workflow 2; old numbering had implement=7, verify=8, archive=9, review=10, finish=11.)

Toolchain facts true in any clone of this repo: (1) The beads integration sets git core.hooksPath to .beads/hooks, which OVERRIDES .git/hooks entirely. Consequence: the Python pre-commit framework CANNOT be installed — 'pre-commit install' aborts with 'Cowardly refusing to install hooks with core.hooksPath set', so 'make install' silently leaves ruff ungated and CI's make check catches the drift later. bd does NOT chain to .git/hooks or to pre-commit. (2) VERIFIED FIX (2026-07-25): bd's 'chaining' means user content placed in .beads/hooks/<hook> OUTSIDE its BEGIN/END BEADS INTEGRATION markers. Tested: such content runs after bd's own block, and a non-zero exit from it DOES block the commit; and 'bd hooks install --beads' preserves it across reinstall/upgrade. Because .beads/hooks/ is git-tracked, a gate added there works on every machine automatically — strictly better than pre-commit's own per-clone .git/hooks install. So gate ruff by appending the invocation to .beads/hooks/pre-commit below the END marker. (3) The beads Dolt DB and issues.jsonl export live in the MAIN checkout's .beads/, not in worktrees — bd commands work from a worktree but export to the main path, so a worktree's committed issues.jsonl can be stale. (4) Worktrees get only 'uv sync', not 'make install'. (5) The issues.jsonl export lags the bd write: a bd close/update may not hit the file until a later bd command flushes it, so re-check git status after bd operations before assuming the export is committed.
